title: Word-Representable Near-Triangulations
exact_target: Determine exactly which plane graphs with triangular bounded faces and a four-vertex clique have a representing word.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1433 (GRAPH-046). CC BY 4.0.

Suchanda Roy and Ramesh Hariharasubramanian, Characterization of Word-Representable Near-Triangulations, arXiv:2605.25733v1 (2026), Sections 1--2, near-triangulation definition and word-representability.
